summary: Tested availability editing from the Staff/Volunteer record (D · Disponibilità section), the PUT /persons/{pid}/availability/{eid} and GET /events/{id}/fasce-giorni endpoints, Copertura oraria (Mansione filter removed, team filter and sorting) and isolation between organisations. Backend: 13 of 14 pytest tests pass. The one failure is minor: the endpoint returns 500 when fasce is not a list. Frontend: every requested flow works in the real UI with TEST orgs registered through register-organization. Covered: staff record (public form preselection), volunteer, new person, legacy free-hours availability (exact match preselected, amber box, 'Sostituirà…', 'Mantieni originale', keep, replace), the confirmation when closing with unsaved changes, and Copertura counts updating right after a save.

minor.issue: body.days is List[dict] with no validation. {days:[{date, fasce: 5}]} returns HTTP 500 (TypeError at set(d.get('fasce'))). A string such as 'mattina' is turned into a set of characters and silently ignored. Use a Pydantic model: date: str, fasce: List[Literal['mattina','pomeriggio']] = [], keep: bool = False.

A keep:true entry whose date is not in the stored record is silently dropped (no error). Days left out of the payload are also deleted, because the payload fully replaces the days. The UI sends every day so this works today, but API clients must know it is not a merge.

issues: The selected event resets to 'Seleziona evento…' after switching to the Staff tab and back (the component remounts) when the org has more than one event. This is a small UX nuisance.
'Fabbisogno minimo' uses native time inputs that show 08:00 AM in en locale. This already existed and is outside the scope of this task.
people-taglia-filter options (tagliaOpts) come in the order they appear in the rows, not in the logical size order (XS,S,M,L,XL…) the requirement asks for.

action_items: Add Pydantic validation to PersonAvailIn.days (Literal fasce, keep bool, date str) so bad input returns 422 instead of 500.
(Optional) Sort tagliaOpts in the Staff filter by the configured settings.taglie order.
(Optional) Keep the Copertura event selection when switching tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py person_avail_update: if several availability records exist, the latest one (by updated_at/created_at) is updated, which is consistent with coverage._load and avail_prefs.latest_avs. Verified: an older duplicate is left untouched and the person is counted once per slot.

PersonAvailability initState skips days with disponibile===false, so saving from the record drops those 'not available' days from the stored record. This is probably harmless, but it is a silent data change.

A legacy day that exactly matches a slot is preselected and is converted to fasce form on the next save of that record (only when some other change makes the record dirty). This matches the requirement but happens without an explicit confirmation.
server.py is 14.5k lines; the new endpoints could live in avail_prefs.py.
